title: Umuhanga mu by'ubuhanga mu by'ikinyoma
intro: Umuntu ukomeye cyane yigeze gukorera umwe mu banyagitugu bazwi cyane mu mateka mu Misiri ya kera. Uyu muntu yahawe itegeko ry’ubutwari - ryo kubaka inyubako yagenewe kurwanya ijuru. Inkuru yabo iri muri Korowani nk'isomo rikomeye ryerekana uburyo kumvira ubwibone buhumyi bijyana gusa mu irimbuka.
clues: Nakoreye mu ngoro z'umutegetsi ukomeye wavugaga ko ari Imana ku bihugu.
Nari mfite umwanya wo hejuru mu buminisitiri, ngira inama umunyagitugu w’umwirasi kurusha abandi bose mu gihe cyanjye.
Umutegetsi wanjye yari yararitswe no guhakana Imana ya Mose, iyo banze kwemera.
Nategetswe kubaka umunara w'amatafari yatwitswe kugira ngo umutegetsi wanjye azamuke ajye mu ijuru.
Umunara ntiwigeze ugera mu ijuru, kandi ubucakara bwanjye bw'ubwibone bwatumye ngira isoni z'iteka ryose.
Napfuye hamwe n'uwo nakurikiye, kandi izina ryanjye ryabaye umuburo uhoraho ku bantu batuma abanyagitugu bakomeza.
